findings.label: Coverage test_inventory drift
findings.detail: docs/spec/coverage/SPEC-ESTABLISHED-RECOVERY-001.yaml still shows tests_executed=false, implementation_changed=false, all TC-ER-00x PLANNED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, and a /private/tmp independent-review path, although the implementation and TC-ER-001..015 tests now exist. Recommend updating the inventory for traceability. Does not affect the spec-check gate, which validates status/approval consistency only.

findings.label: recoveryObservers relies on listener identity convergence
findings.detail: The coordinator observer set is built from connectionListener + reconnectManager.getLastConnectionListener(), not the fault-time listener passed into connectInternal.onDisconnected. In practice they are the same instance and the real-transport wiring test confirms terminal delivery; flagged only as a dependency if divergent per-connect listeners are ever supported.
